summary: @willrich45 I tried teaching an ungrading semester and my students hated it. I needed to spell out the policy better, still use metrics to track progress, and add in much more reflection. Check out the #digped hashtag for a lot of ungrading discussion. #satchat
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @willrich45 I tried teaching an ungrading semester and my students hated it. I needed to spell out the policy better, still use metrics to track progress, and add in much more reflection. Check out the #digped hashtag for a lot of ungrading discussion. #satchat
